name: Min length error and clean-up icon in the "Назва" field
description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.
descriptionHtml:
Admins can create team member categories
and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

testStage.description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

steps.name: Given the admin is logged in
And the admin opens the Team page
And the admin opens the Add category modal
Open the add Team category dialog
When the admin enters "abc" into the "Назва" field
And the admin clicks outside the field
Then the error "Не менше 5 символів" is displayed for the "Назва" field
And the clean-up icon is not displayed in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is hidden in the 'Назва' field
When the admin clicks inside the "Назва" field
Then the clean-up icon is displayed in red in the "Назва" field
Check clean-up icon is shown in the 'Назва' field
